# neuron v0.1.6 — device and update fixes

Windows 10/11 (x86_64). Installer and portable ZIP, with the app and CLI. Unsigned binaries; check `SHA256SUMS.txt`. `SOURCE.txt` records the source commit.

A small bugfix release.

- Fixed lighting ownership after host recovery and an OpenRGB crash after resizing a device surface.
- Newly adopted keyboards refresh M-key handling without restarting Neuron.
- Device reads and discovery reject malformed replies, including incomplete Logitech replies.
- Windows setup, updates and removal preserve other Neuron copies and their startup target. The updater distinguishes installed, portable and source copies, and skips already-current replacements.
- Chroma broker updates verify the replacement before stopping a working copy and retain a recovery copy until the update succeeds.

No new hardware support is claimed. Real setup/UAC/uninstall transitions still need a clean Windows VM run. [Feature status and platform limits](https://github.com/worflor/neuron/blob/v0.1.6/docs/STATUS.md).
